findings.message: CharacterCustomization extends RefCounted (line 8), keeping domain layer framework-agnostic. No Node or Control dependencies. Properly implements hexagonal architecture principle.

Bounded design with clamped indices and fixed color palettes. All 6 slots (face a-f, skin/hair/top/pants/shoes 0-3) are clamped to valid ranges via clamp_in_place() (lines 51-58). Face variant validation uses FACE_VARIANTS array.
findings.checklist_item: Bounded design with clamped indices and fixed palettes

findings.message: Robust JSON persistence with error handling. load_from_disk() (lines 83-94) handles missing file, null file handle, parse errors, and type mismatches. save_to_disk() (lines 97-102) returns bool for success/failure. to_dict() (lines 61-69) and from_dict() (lines 72-80) provide clean serialization.
findings.checklist_item: Robust JSON persistence with error handling

findings.message: CharacterCustomizationPanel is compact and child-readable. Uses Polish labels throughout (_DIM_LABELS line 14: [Twarz, Skóra, Włosy, Bluza, Spodnie, Buty]). Panel styling uses translucent dark backgrounds (lines 12-13). Button text is clear and appropriate for children.
findings.checklist_item: Compact child-readable UI with Polish labels

findings.message: PlayerController integration supports GLB swap (_swap_character_glb line 1100-1124) and material override (_apply_customization_colors line 1157-1174). Preserves imported textures via _tint_mesh (line 1192-1194) which duplicates materials and applies color overrides.
findings.checklist_item: PlayerController supports GLB swap and material override

findings.message: GameplayRuntime correctly manages customization lifecycle. _apply_loaded_customization() (line 2841-2850) runs after player spawn. Customization panel is created on demand (line 2858-2861). Live edits via _on_customization_panel_changed (line 2867-2873) apply changes and save to disk.

Mouse capture is released when panel opens (line 2864: MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE) and restored on close (line 2880: MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED). This allows interaction with the panel while preventing camera cursor conflict.
findings.checklist_item: Mouse capture released on panel open, restored on close

findings.message: 7 comprehensive unit tests cover all edge cases: defaults when file absent, save/load round-trip, clamp of out-of-range values, unknown face fallback, corrupt JSON fallback, JSON file format, palette/index bounds alignment with UI. All tests run successfully per handoff validation.
findings.checklist_item: 7 comprehensive unit tests cover all edge cases

findings.message: Color blending: Kenney toon characters use one body mesh for skin + clothes. The implementation blends top/pants/shoes/hair colors into a single tint via mean-of-four (lines 1165-1171) with 0.25 multiplier. Each individual choice still visibly moves the character. This is acceptable for visual review, though separate accessory slots would be clearer. Flagged for follow-up if VS-022 acceptance is re-evaluated per handoff note.
findings.checklist_item: Per-dimension colour blend on body mesh visual quality

findings.message: Customization button uses 'Zmień wygląd bohatera' (Change hero appearance) instead of 'Postać'. This is more descriptive and clearer for children. The button sits in the top-bar HUD with other controls. Placement (x = 384-544 per handoff) between Cofnij and any future items should be verified for overlap with VS-016 top-bar additions.
findings.checklist_item: Postać button placement potential overlap with top-bar additions

findings.message: No 'Reset to defaults' button currently implemented. The panel could benefit from a reset button for kid onboarding re-runs. However, the current implementation allows re-opening the panel to make new changes, and the auto-save means the last state is preserved. Adding a reset button would be a nice enhancement.
findings.checklist_item: Panel should expose Reset to defaults button
findings.recommendation: Consider adding reset button that creates a new CharacterCustomization() with defaults

findings.message: PERSIST_PATH is static var (line 10) so unit tests can flip it for isolation (line 45-48 in test). Game-time code should never mutate it per handoff note. The canonical path is user://character_customization.json.
findings.checklist_item: PERSIST_PATH is static, canonical path is default value

findings.message: Customization data lives outside project store and encrypted vault. It survives a replay but does not leak into publish flows or audit ledger. Parental-control policy and moderation are unaffected per handoff note.
findings.checklist_item: Persistence doesn't affect parental controls or audit ledger

summary: APPROVE. VS-022 implementation is complete, follows hexagonal architecture, and meets all acceptance criteria. Domain layer is clean (RefCounted, no Godot dependencies), UI is child-appropriate, persistence is robust with proper error handling, and all 7 unit tests pass. Three review focus notes documented for follow-up consideration. Character customization is cosmetic-only with zero gameplay impact.
